name: Clonazepam
executiveSummary: Long half-life benzodiazepine. Adult epilepsy/myoclonus: **0.5–1 mg PO q8h** titrate (usual max **4–20 mg/day** by indication). Panic: **0.25–0.5 mg q12h**. Pediatric epilepsy: start **0.01–0.03 mg/kg/day**. Dependence — controlled courses.
indications:
## Indications

- Epilepsy (atypical absences, myoclonus, adjunct Lennox-Gastaut); panic disorder; myoclonus.

## Precautions

- Sedation, respiratory depression with opioids/alcohol.
- Dependence/withdrawal — do not stop abruptly.
- Elderly: falls; lowest doses.

> Drops help pediatric/geriatric titration.

adulto.dose: Epilepsy: start **0.5 mg q8h** → titrate weekly; usual maintenance **2–8 mg/day** (labels up to **20 mg**). Panic: **0.25 mg q12h** → often **1–2 mg/day**.

pediatrico.dose: Epilepsy: start **0.01–0.03 mg/kg/day** in 2–3 doses; maintenance **0.1–0.2 mg/kg/day** (max by age/label).

adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Somnolence, ataxia, sialorrhea (children), paradoxical irritability, dependence.
